Sergeant '''Nayon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], where he also sold various [[Stimulant/Legends|stims]].
